scripts.dev:web: npm run dist:desktop && npx cross-env VITE_APP_TARGET=web VITE_ENABLE_WEB=true VITE_ENABLE_DESKTOP=false vite
scripts.dev:desktop: npx cross-env VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop VITE_ENABLE_WEB=false VITE_ENABLE_DESKTOP=true electron-vite dev
scripts.build:web: npm run dist:desktop && npx cross-env VITE_APP_TARGET=web VITE_ENABLE_WEB=true VITE_ENABLE_DESKTOP=false tsc -b && vite build
scripts.build:desktop: npx cross-env VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop VITE_ENABLE_WEB=false VITE_ENABLE_DESKTOP=true electron-vite build
scripts.dist:desktop: npx cross-env VITE_APP_TARGET=desktop VITE_ENABLE_WEB=false VITE_ENABLE_DESKTOP=true electron-vite build && electron-builder && npm run prepare:desktop-download
scripts.prepare:desktop-download: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); const path = require('path'); const rel = 'release'; const tgt = 'public/downloads'; if (!fs.existsSync(rel)) { console.error('❌ release directory not found'); process.exit(1); } const exe = fs.readdirSync(rel).find(f => f.endsWith('.exe') && !f.includes('uninstaller')); if (exe) { fs.mkdirSync(tgt, { recursive: true }); fs.copyFileSync(path.join(rel, exe), path.join(tgt, 'CentrixG-Setup.exe')); console.log('✓ Desktop installer copied:', exe, '-> public/downloads/CentrixG-Setup.exe'); } else { console.error('❌ No .exe file found in release directory'); }"
